history.summary: Reviewed commit 72ce67f (addMonths month-rollover fix) via git show and manual trace. Small, self-contained, no new bug found. 이상 없음 — no fix committed this phase.

IMPORTANT CONTEXT for whoever picks this up next: this cycle's local /app-evolve run was interleaved with discovering that the hourly CLOUD routine (trig_01FMhZiCL2WSVBEf9u7CB5Dj) had just fired for the first time and hit a real problem — its ephemeral container had no persisted state.json (it lived under .claude/app-evolve/, untracked) so it restarted at cycle 0/develop, found a genuinely good bug on its own (assetSubline() rounds fractional stockQty/fxAmount to integers via comma(), disagreeing with the unrounded values assetEval() already uses for net-worth totals), implemented and committed it locally, but git push failed with a 403 (org-level GitHub App not authorized for write access) and the commit was stranded in the ephemeral container and is now unrecoverable. Surfaced this to the user, who reinstalled/reconnected the GitHub App. A manual re-run (session cse_01WghP2kGdzPWycGGhsAB3nB) confirmed push now works, but hit a SECOND, more fundamental problem: it tried to write .claude/app-evolve/state.json and got stuck on a permission prompt for editing a 'sensitive file' under .claude/ — with no human present to approve, the session deadlocked (worker_status: requires_action) and never completed. Root-caused: (1) .claude/ paths are treated as sensitive and gate on human approval in the cloud environment, which is fundamentally incompatible with unattended execution; (2) even if that weren't blocked, an untracked/uncommitted state file can never survive across cloud runs anyway, since each run clones a fresh container from git — only what's committed persists. FIXED as part of this same turn (a distinct, necessary infrastructure correction, not a normal rotation phase): migrated the state file out of .claude/ entirely to a plain repo-root file, app-evolve-state.json, and updated both the project-level skill (.claude/skills/app-evolve/SKILL.md, committed to this repo, used by the cloud routine) and the local user-level skill (~/.claude/skills/app-evolve/SKILL.md) to (a) use this new path and (b) commit app-evolve-state.json on EVERY phase from now on, including critique and no-op reviews (previously state.json was deliberately left uncommitted/working-tree-only, which is what caused this whole class of problem). BANKED CANDIDATE for a future develop cycle (small, already-scoped, but the fix that was found for it got lost): add a commaQty() formatter (Number.isInteger(n)?comma(n):n.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:4})) and use it in assetSubline() for a.fxAmount/a.stockQty in place of comma(), matching how a.goldDon is already shown unrounded. This critique phase's actual pending_advance_plan (chosen before the infra issue was discovered, still valid and worth doing next) is the regression-test-suite plan above — a lightweight Node test runner covering the pure-logic functions fixed across cycles 0-4, since there is still zero permanent safety net for any of this project's hard-won edge-case fixes.

Implemented the critique plan: added our-assets-v1.14.1/our-assets/test/run.js, a dependency-free Node regression suite (assert-based, no package.json) that extracts pure-logic function source directly out of index.html via a vm sandbox and runs 15 assertions covering the bugs fixed in cycles 0-4 — addMonths month-rollover/leap-year clamping, recDates monthly day-clamp, recNthDate/recCountUntil weekend-adjustment round-trip, num()'s sign-stripping, doRenameCat's catVar/catIcon migration (including the linked-recurrence category/memo update), and activeRecsForAssets (single id + Set). Sanity-checked the harness by reintroducing the old buggy addMonths into a scratch copy of index.html — 3 of the 15 tests correctly failed, confirming it actually catches regressions rather than being tautological. All 15 pass against the real index.html (`node test/run.js`, exit 0). No app runtime code changed (test/ isn't in sw.js's SHELL cache list), so APP_VERSION/CACHE were left untouched. Added a short pointer to the new suite in both SKILL.md's pre-check step 4 and its safety-rules section so future develop/review/advance phases run it before committing changes to the covered functions. pending_advance_plan cleared.
